description: A landing hero where shapes drop in, pile up under the headline and can be grabbed and thrown.

name: AI Text Loading
description: AI thinking text with a soft wave through the letters and words that swap letter by letter.

name: Momentum Rail
description: A card rail you flick with momentum, snapping on a spring, with scroll-driven cover-flow depth and parallax.

name: File Upload
description: A multi-file upload queue with per-file progress, retry and cancel.

name: Command Palette
description: âŒ˜K command palette with nested pages, fuzzy matching and in-row progress for running actions.

name: AI Input Search
description: AI composer with a Tools menu (browse, investigate, draft, run code, reason), a model picker and a live trace that stacks each source's avatar as it is read.

name: Cradle Text
description: A headline hung like a Newton's cradle, so a knock on one letter clacks through the word, built with React and pendulum physics.

name: Currency Transfer
description: Transfer tracker that converts the amount in place, walks through each step on a filling rail and ends with a copyable reference.

name: Background Paths
description: A ribbon of lines in one color that keeps flowing at any size and parts around the cursor.

name: Dot Field
description: A halftone dot membrane that ripples behind a swipe and rings out from a click, built with React and Canvas.

name: Wind
description: Streamlines that part around the cursor, swirl in its wake and scatter on click, built with React and Canvas.

name: Topo Background
description: A living contour map that drifts, rises under the cursor and ripples on click, built with React and Canvas.

name: Drape Background
description: A pleated curtain in a breeze that you can push and pull, built with React, WebGL and a cloth simulation.

name: Apple Activity Card
description: Activity rings that draw with a count-up, lap past 100% with a shadowed end cap and dim to focus, built with React and Motion.

name: AI Voice
description: Voice input with a scrolling waveform, then a take you can play back, discard or send.

name: Swipe Tabs
description: Tabs with a swipeable panel, a drag-tracked indicator and spring physics.

name: Marking Menu
description: A radial menu you hold to open or flick to pick blind, built with React and Motion.

name: Team Selector
description: Seat picker with a scrubbable number, generated avatars and an optional rolling price line.

name: Detent Dial
description: Rotary knob that clicks from notch to notch and coasts when flicked, built with React and Motion.

name: Liquid Slider
description: A vertical slider you fill like a glass, with a sloshing surface and rising bubbles.

name: Signature Pad
description: A signature field with a sprung pen tip, speed-weighted ink and SVG output.

name: Switch Button
description: Light and dark theme toggle whose sun folds into a moon while the new theme spreads from the button as a circle.

name: Pull Cord
description: A lamp switch you pull on a swinging cord, built with React and a rope simulation.

name: Tear Button
description: A confirm button you tear off like a ticket stub, hole by hole.

name: Bell Button
description: A subscribe button whose bell swings and rings, with a clapper that really strikes.

name: Widget Grid
description: Dashboard widgets you lift, drag and resize on a 6-column grid, with spring physics and full keyboard support.

name: Hold Button
description: Press and hold to confirm, with a fill that drains back on early release and a drawn check on completion.

name: Magnet Button
description: A call-to-action button wrapped in a field of iron filings that align to its magnetic field and lean toward your cursor.

name: Gradient Button
description: Layered gradient button with emerald, purple and orange variants, a gradient border, a soft inner glow, press feedback and an optional icon.

name: V0 Button
description: Open in v0 button that sends a component registry JSON to v0.dev for instant editing, built with React, the shadcn Button, and Tailwind CSS.

name: Tool Dock
description: An editor tool dock with a sliding selection plate, shortcut tooltips and flyouts that you can throw to any edge.

name: AI State Loading
description: Agent progress as a list of steps with a live log, elapsed time and a summary when done.

name: AI Tool Approval
description: Approve or deny an agent's tool calls. Destructive calls need a press and hold, and decided calls fold into a trace with their output.

name: AI Context Meter
description: How full the context window is, as a ring in the prompt footer that opens a breakdown by source and compacts when it fills.

name: AI Inline Citations
description: An answer with source chips beside each claim. One preview glides between chips and lights up the sentence it backs.

name: AI Diff Review
description: A coding agent's edits streaming in file by file, then reviewed per file with accept, reject and undo.

name: AI Model Selector
description: Pick a model and how hard it thinks. Effort is a detent track that reshapes for each model and keeps your level when you switch.

name: Throw Deck
description: A pile of image cards you drag, flick off the top and send under the deck, with arrow keys and a details view.

name: Notification Stack
description: Stacked notifications that fan out on hover and swipe away, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

name: Liquid Gauge
description: A usage meter filled with liquid that sloshes, ripples and bubbles, built with React and a wave simulation.

name: Activity Terrain
description: A contribution heatmap that tilts up into a 3D terrain you can turn, built with React and canvas.

name: Receipt Printer
description: A receipt that prints line by line, then tears off and falls when you pull it, built with React.

name: Metric Card
description: A revenue KPI card. Scrub a day, drag a range, or pick a segment; the number rolls, the line morphs and the breakdown follows.

name: Uptime Card
description: A status page card with 90 days per service that swell under the cursor, and a day you click opens its incident log.

name: Spending Ring
description: A spending breakdown you spin like a dial; flick the ring and it settles with a category under the marker.

name: Focal Point Picker
description: Set where a photo's subject is and see every crop follow it live. Hover a crop to see what it cuts.

name: Photo Straighten
description: Level a crooked photo on a ruler you drag or flick. The crop grows to hide the corners, and a grid shows while you adjust.

name: Clip Trimmer
description: A video trim timeline with a filmstrip, handles that snap to whole seconds and a playhead that loops the kept range.

name: Synced Transcript
description: A transcript that follows the spoken word, lets you click any word to jump there, and waits when you scroll away.

name: Avatar Picker
description: Generated avatars from a name, morphing as you type, on a 3D coin you can flick, tap or shuffle.

name: Wheel Picker
description: iOS-style 3D drum picker with flick momentum, built with React and Motion.

name: Typing Text
description: Typewriter text that makes the odd typo and corrects it, erases by selecting, and blinks its caret only when idle, built with React and Motion.

name: Extruded Text
description: Zinc 3D extruded text lit by your pointer, with letters that press in like keycaps.

name: Scroll Index
description: A section rail for long pages, with a tick per heading that you can hover, click or drag to scrub, built with React.

name: Plucked Text
description: A headline sitting on a string you can pluck, strum and let ring, built with React and real string physics.

name: Glitch Text
description: Flat text that cuts into hard-shifted bands with a thin red/cyan split, on idle, hover or text change.

name: Dynamic Text
description: Morphing text where shared letters travel, old ones fall and new ones land, with decode and cycle modes.

name: Particle Button
description: A status button for async actions, with a spinner, a drawn check and a particle burst on success.

name: Now Playing
description: Music card with a spinning disc you can grab and turn to scrub, built with React and Tailwind CSS.

name: Account Menu
description: An account card that morphs into its own menu, with account switching, status, theme and hold-to-sign-out.

name: Loader
description: Animated loading indicator with rotating gradient rings, size variants and customizable title text. Built with React and Tailwind CSS.

name: Slide Text Button
description: Animated link button with a vertical text slide on hover and default and ghost variants, built with React, Next.js Link, and Tailwind CSS.

name: Split Nav
description: Navigation bar that splits around the active link, with drag-to-scrub, flick projection and an optional compact fold.

name: Status Island
description: A pill that reports background work, reshaping as tasks change and opening into a list of everything in flight.

name: Morph Popover
description: A button that grows into the form it opens, with its label sliding up to become the title, then shrinks into a confirmation.

name: Lightbox Grid
description: A photo grid whose thumbnails grow into a full view and fly back to their slot when you drag them down.

name: Spoiler Text
description: Inline text hidden under drifting specks, like a chat spoiler. A click blows the specks away from the point you touched.

name: Stack Panel
description: A panel that drills into pages like settings on a phone. The tapped row's label flies up into the title, and a swipe right takes you back.

name: AI Autocomplete
description: A text box that suggests how your sentence ends in grey after the caret. Tab takes it all, the right arrow takes one word, and typing the same letters keeps it.

name: Undo Button
description: An action button that gives you a few seconds to take it back, with the time left drawn around its own edge.

name: Time Zone Planner
description: Find a meeting time across time zones. Turn the meeting round a 24-hour dial where each ring is someone's day.

name: Page Flip
description: A book you turn by the corner. Drag a page over the spine or tap to turn it.

name: AI Token Alternatives
description: An answer where every unsure word shows what else the model weighed. Pick another word and the reply writes itself again from there.

name: AI Conversation Branches
description: A chat where editing a message starts a new branch. A small tree beside it shows every version, and you can jump between them.

name: AI Agent Lanes
description: A lead agent hands work to sub-agents that run side by side. Each gets a lane of tool calls, and you can scrub through the whole run.

name: AI Inline Edit
description: Select text in a document and ask AI to rewrite it. The edit streams in place as a word-level diff you accept, discard or try again.

name: AI Message Queue
description: Keep typing while the agent works. Follow-ups stack above the composer, where you can reorder, edit or send one now, and go in one by one when the run ends.

name: AI Redact
description: Masks names, emails, card numbers and keys as placeholders before a prompt is sent, then fills the real values back into the reply.

name: AI Memory
description: An assistant that saves what it learns about you into a memory list. New facts replace the ones they contradict, and you can edit or forget any of them.

name: Marker Text
description: Hand-drawn highlights, underlines, circles, boxes and strikes that draw themselves in reading order when the text comes into view.

name: Ink Background
description: A hero written in ink on water. Stir it and the letters bleed, click to drop ink, and the headline gathers itself again. Built with WebGL.

name: Caustics Background
description: A hero on the floor of a pool. Light ripples across it, clicks drop rings that bend the light, and the headline's shadow wobbles below.

name: Rain Glass Background
description: A hero seen through a rainy window. Drops gather and run, each a tiny lens on the view, and dragging wipes the fog off the glass.

name: Shadow Text
description: A headline that works as a sundial. Each letter casts a long, soft shadow set by the reader's clock, and bringing the pointer close turns it into a lamp.

name: Seat Map
description: Pick seats for a show. Drag along a row to take several, and it points out any single seat you'd leave stranded.

name: Amount Pad
description: A keypad for sending money. Digits spring into place, commas slide them along, and the amount shrinks to fit as it grows.

name: Slide to Confirm
description: A confirm control for payments and other actions you can't take back. Slide the thumb to the end, or flick it.

name: Save Button
description: A bookmark button that files into collections. Tap to save to the last one, then change it or make a new one from the strip.

name: Cart Button
description: An Add button that opens into a quantity stepper in place, with a bin at one and press-and-hold to repeat.

name: Card Field
description: A one-row card input for checkout. The number groups the way the brand prints it, then slides to its last four to make room for expiry and CVC.

name: Stay Picker
description: A date range picker for booking stays. Every night shows its price, sold-out nights are hatched, and your stay is one pill that wraps across weeks.

name: Slot Picker
description: Book a meeting on a day rail. Drag a meeting into a free gap; it hops over existing bookings, resizes in place and shows the host's local time.

name: Tip Selector
description: A tip picker for checkout, set on a tape you drag and flick. The ticks you pass fill in, the amounts roll, and Round up makes the total a whole amount.

name: Boarding Pass
description: A boarding pass that keeps itself current. When the gate or times change, only the changed characters roll over, the old value struck through.

name: Split Flap Text
description: Departure-board lettering for headlines and status lines. Each tile flips only as far as its new letter, on a hinge, a beat after its neighbour.

name: Location Picker
description: Set a pickup point the way ride apps do. Drag the map under a fixed pin; it lifts off its shadow, glides onto the nearest curb, drops, and the street rolls in.

name: Contact Sheet
description: Pick from a shoot the way photographers do. Circle a frame in china marker, click again to strike it, and look through a loupe at the detail first.

name: Use Auto Resize Textarea
description: React hook that auto-resizes a textarea to fit its content between a min and max height.

name: Use Click Outside
description: React hook that runs a callback when the user clicks outside the referenced element.

name: Use Copy To Clipboard
description: React hook that copies text to the clipboard and exposes a copied state with a reset timeout.

name: Use Mobile
description: React hook that reports whether the viewport is below the 768px mobile breakpoint.

name: Utils
description: The cn utility for merging Tailwind CSS classes, built on clsx and tailwind-merge.

name: Accordion
description: A collapsible content component with smooth animations for showing and hiding content.

name: Animated Background
description: A component that provides animated background effects for UI elements.

name: Animated Group
description: A container component that applies coordinated animations to a group of child elements.

name: Animated Number
description: A component that animates number changes with smooth transitions.

name: Border Trail
description: An effect that creates animated border trails around elements on interaction.

name: Carousel
description: A component for cycling through elements with smooth transitions.

name: Cursor
description: A custom cursor component with animated effects and interactions.

name: Dialog
description: A modal dialog component with smooth entrance and exit animations.

name: Disclosure
description: A component that shows and hides content with animated transitions.

name: In View
description: A component that triggers animations when elements enter the viewport.

name: Infinite Slider
description: A slider component that loops infinitely through its content.

name: Transition Panel
description: A panel component with smooth transitions between different states.

name: Text Effect
description: A component that applies animated effects to text content.

name: Text Loop
description: A component that cycles through different text phrases with animations.

name: Text Morph
description: A component that morphs between different text strings with smooth transitions.

name: Text Roll
description: A component that animates text with a rolling effect.

name: Text Scramble
description: A component that creates a scrambling text effect during transitions.

name: Text Shimmer
description: A component that applies a shimmering effect to text.

name: Text Shimmer Wave
description: A component that creates a wave-like shimmer effect on text.

name: Magnetic
description: A component that creates a magnetic attraction effect on hover.

name: Morphing Dialog
description: A dialog that morphs from its trigger element with smooth transitions.

name: Morphing Popover
description: A popover component that morphs from its trigger with fluid animations.

name: Dock
description: A macOS-style dock component with scaling and movement effects.

name: Glow Effect
description: A component that creates a glowing effect on elements based on cursor movement.

name: Image Comparison
description: A component for comparing two images with an interactive slider.

name: Toolbar Dynamic
description: A toolbar component with dynamic appearance based on user interaction.

name: Toolbar Expandable
description: An expandable toolbar that reveals additional options with animations.

name: Progressive Blur
description: A component that applies progressive blur effects to elements.

name: Scroll Progress
description: A component that visualizes scroll progress with animated indicators.

name: Sliding Number
description: A component that transitions between numbers with a sliding animation.

name: Spotlight
description: A component that creates a spotlight effect following cursor movement.

name: Spinning Text
description: A component that animates text with a spinning rotation effect.

name: Tilt
description: A component that applies 3D tilt effects to elements based on cursor position.

name: Auto Height
description: A container that animates its height to fit its content whenever it changes.

name: Avatar Group
description: Overlapping avatars where the hovered one rises, with a tooltip that glides from avatar to avatar.

name: Blur
description: An entrance that brings elements into focus on load or when they scroll into view.

name: Bottom Navigation
description: A bottom bar whose highlight glides to the selected item, and that can fold to it or slide away while the page scrolls down.

name: Button
description: A button that presses down when tapped.

name: Click
description: A visual effect played where the pointer clicks: a ring, a ripple, a crosshair, a burst or particles.

name: Code Block
description: A code block highlighted with Shiki that can type its code out, character by character.

name: Copy Button
description: A button that copies text to the clipboard, its icon swapping for a check.

name: Counting Number
description: A number that counts up to its value, written straight to the DOM.

name: Cursor
description: A custom cursor, and a label that follows it, inside an area or across the page.

name: Effect
description: An entrance that combines fade, blur, slide and zoom on load or when elements scroll into view.

name: Fade
description: An entrance that fades elements in on load or when they scroll into view.

name: Flip Button
description: A button that flips over on hover to reveal its back face.

name: GitHub Stars Button
description: A button showing a repository's GitHub stars, counted up with a filling star.

name: GitHub Stars
description: A repository's GitHub stars, counted up with a filling star and a burst of particles.

name: Gradient Text
description: Text filled with a gradient that sweeps slowly across it.

name: Highlight Text
description: Text with a background that sweeps in from the left, like a highlighter.

name: Highlight
description: A background that glides between items on click, on hover or with a controlled value.

name: Icon Button
description: A button that bursts into particles when clicked.

name: Image Zoom
description: An image that zooms in where the pointer is, on hover or on click.

name: Input OTP
description: Accessible one-time password input where typed characters pop in and a pasted code staggers in. A drop-in replacement for input-otp, with the same API.

name: Liquid Button
description: A button that fills with color from the bottom on hover.

name: Magnetic
description: An element pulled toward the pointer when it comes close.

name: Morphing Text
description: Text that morphs from one string to the next, letters gliding to their new place.

name: Motion Grid
description: A grid of dots that plays frame-by-frame animations, for loading and status indicators.

name: Page Transition
description: Animated transitions between pages, built on view transitions, for Next.js, React Router and TanStack Router.

name: Particles
description: A burst of particles around an element, for likes, stars and other celebrations.

name: Pinned List
description: A list whose items glide between a pinned and an unpinned group.

name: Ripple Button
description: A button that sends a ripple out from where it is clicked.

name: Rolling Text
description: Text whose letters roll over one after another, like a flip board.

name: Rotating Text
description: Words that take turns in place, each one sliding out as the next slides in.

name: Scroll Fade
description: A scroll container whose edges fade only where there is more to scroll, animated as you scroll.

name: Scroll Progress
description: A progress bar that follows the scroll position of the page or of a container.

name: Scrolling Number
description: A wheel of numbers that spins to its value and settles under a highlight.

name: Shimmering Text
description: Text with a glint of light that runs across its letters.

name: Shine
description: A light that sweeps across an element, once, in a loop, on hover or on tap.

name: Slide
description: An entrance that slides elements into place on load or when they scroll into view.

name: Sliding Number
description: A number whose digits roll to their new value, like an odometer.

name: Sliding Text
description: Text that slides out of its box while a copy slides in, on hover or on click, like a menu link.

name: Splitting Text
description: Text that comes in piece by piece, by character, word or line.

name: Spring
description: A draggable element tied to its place by a spring coil, which pulls it back on release.

name: Swapping Text
description: Text that swaps to a new value letter by letter, each changed letter sliding out as the new one slides in.

name: Tabs
description: Animate UI's own tabs: a highlight glides between triggers and panels slide, with the height following the active panel.

name: Theme Toggler Button
description: A button that cycles the theme, its icon turning into the next one.

name: Theme Toggler
description: A theme switch that wipes the new theme across the page with the View Transitions API.

name: Tilt
description: A card that tilts in 3D toward the pointer.

name: Tooltip
description: Animate UI's own tooltip: the tooltips of a provider share one popup that moves from trigger to trigger instead of closing and reopening.

name: Typing Text
description: Text typed character by character, with an optional blinking cursor.

name: Cursor

name: Effect

name: Fade

name: Flip Button

name: Highlight Text
description: Text with a background that sweeps in from the left, like a highlighter.

name: Highlight
description: A background that glides between items on click, on hover or with a controlled value.

name: Icon Button
description: A button that bursts into particles when clicked.

name: Image Zoom
description: An image that zooms in where the pointer is, on hover or on click.

name: Liquid Button
description: A button that fills with color from the bottom on hover.

name: Magnetic
description: An element pulled toward the pointer when it comes close.

name: Morphing Text
description: Text that morphs from one string to the next, letters gliding to their new place.

name: Motion Grid

name: Page Transition

name: Particles
description: A burst of particles around an element, for likes, stars and other celebrations.

name: Pinned List

name: Ripple Button

name: Rolling Text
description: Text whose letters roll over one after another, like a flip board.

name: Rotating Text
description: Words that take turns in place, each one sliding out as the next slides in.

name: Scroll Fade
description: A scroll container whose edges fade only where there is more to scroll, animated as you scroll.

name: Scroll Progress
description: A progress bar that follows the scroll position of the page or of a container.

name: Scrolling Number
description: A wheel of numbers that spins to its value and settles under a highlight.

name: Shimmering Text
description: Text with a glint of light that runs across its letters.

name: Shine
description: A light that sweeps across an element, once, in a loop, on hover or on tap.

name: Slide
description: An entrance that slides elements into place on load or when they scroll into view.

name: Sliding Number
description: A number whose digits roll to their new value, like an odometer.

name: Sliding Text
description: Text that slides out of its box while a copy slides in, on hover or on click, like a menu link.

name: Splitting Text
description: Text that comes in piece by piece, by character, word or line.

name: Spring
description: A draggable element tied to its place by a spring coil, which pulls it back on release.

name: Swapping Text

name: Tilt

name: Tooltip

name: Zoom

name: Combobox

Preplex Hero Section
This is a hero section made for a waitlist page. The background uses vertical red and black bars that fade upward. Under that there is a line that tells people to be the first to know when the product launches and to join the waitlist for early access.

At the top right there is a join the waitlist button. In the center above the heading there is a small section with profile images and a number that shows how many people are already on the waitlist. In this case it says 2 point 4 K currently on the waitlist.

Below the main heading there is a rounded input field that says enter your email. Next to that there is a button that says join the waitlist. Both of these are centered and placed near the bottom of the hero section.

At the very bottom there are small icons for social links like Instagram LinkedIn and GitHub. At the top left the brand name There is a basic menu with links for features vision press and contact.
The layout is centered. The text is clear and uses large font sizes.

name: 3D Globe
description: A Terra em 3D com a textura de satélite e o relevo, girando sozinha, com fotos presas às cidades por alfinetes que somem quando elas vão para trás. Arraste para girar.

name: 3D Testimonials
description: Uma parede de depoimentos inclinada em 3D: colunas de cartões que correm sem parar, uma para cima e a outra para baixo, sumindo nas bordas. A coluna sob o mouse para e o cartão sob ele acende.

name: AI Prompt Box
description: Caixa de mensagem de chat de IA: o texto cresce com as linhas, os modos Pesquisar, Pensar e Canvas acendem com o ícone girando, a imagem entra pelo clipe ou colada, e o botão redondo vira microfone, enviar ou parar.

name: Âncora
description: Preço num card só: três ofertas num seletor deslizante, dígitos que rolam e adicionais que somam no total.

name: Animated Mosaic Portrait
description: Um retrato redesenhado em ladrilhos, cada um com a cor média da foto, e uma onda de luz que atravessa a imagem na diagonal sem parar. Canvas2D puro, sem dependências.

name: Apoteose
description: O teto de Versalhes, a Apoteose de Hércules, em 30 mil caracteres na cor da pintura; uma lente segue o cursor e mostra de perto que é tudo texto.

name: Aurora
description: Faixas de luz rosa, gelo e lilás sob uma curva que afunda no centro e cede ao cursor, sobre preto.

name: Avatar Group
description: Fotos redondas sobrepostas numa fileira: o avatar sob o mouse sobe, passa para a frente e mostra o nome num balão que salta numa mola. Os que passam do limite viram um círculo com o +N.

name: Campo
description: Rodapé com a foto de um campo ao entardecer e a marca em metal líquido pousada no horizonte, atrás da pessoa e da névoa.

name: Card Fan Carousel
description: Cartões de imagem abertos em leque, como cartas na mão: entram com uma mola elástica, abrem espaço para o cartão sob o mouse e giram em círculo pelas setas.

name: Circular Navigation
description: Menu que abre por cima da página: um círculo de vidro cresce do centro com os itens em volta e o X no meio. Fecha no Esc, no clique fora e na escolha.

name: Clothing Rail Hero
description: Uma arara de roupas na página: as peças ficam de lado no cano e a que está sob o mouse gira para a frente, empurrando as vizinhas, que balançam nos cabides. Dá para arrastar um cabide e tirar uma peça para ver as costas.

name: Cobe Globe
description: Globo 3D em WebGL que gira sozinho, com cidades, arcos entre elas e rótulos presos aos pontos, que somem quando eles vão para trás. Arraste para girar, e ele segue no embalo.

name: Cristal
description: Dupla de botões: a pílula clara com o chip da seta e a pílula de vidro líquido que acende no hover.

name: Cromo
description: Uma palavra em metal líquido: cromo escorrendo por dentro das letras, com a borda puxando para o vermelho e o azul, como luz quebrando num metal polido.

name: Dashboard Sidebar
description: Barra lateral de painel com troca de workspace, subitens que abrem animados, contadores, atalhos de teclado que funcionam e a busca do ⌘K.

name: Draggable Widget Grid
description: Painel de widgets que se reorganiza arrastando: os vizinhos abrem espaço com uma mola e a grade se encaixa sem buracos em qualquer largura.

name: Esteira
description: Duas fileiras de cartões que correm em sentidos opostos conforme a página rola.

name: Finance Bento
description: Painel de finanças pessoais em bento: patrimônio em caixa, ações e cripto numa faixa que cresce, alocação, fluxo de caixa, metas e contas, com período e moeda que redesenham tudo contando.

name: Floating Dock
description: Barra de ícones flutuante como a dock do macOS: o ícone sob o mouse cresce numa mola, os vizinhos acompanham e o nome aparece num balão. No celular, vira um botão que abre os ícones em coluna.

name: Flue
description: Fumaça vermelha subindo pela chaminé em fitas que dobram sem se amontoar; o cursor sopra como uma corrente de ar, e o sopro continua um instante depois que a mão para.

name: Fluxo
description: Tinta líquida marmorizada: plano claro, borda acesa e fitas com estrias que escorrem e giram com o cursor.

name: Glass Folder
description: Pasta de vidro fosco com arquivos de verdade dentro: inclina no hover, abre em leque no clique e ganha arquivo novo no +.

name: Gota
description: Botão azul de app no estilo dos ícones da Apple: degradê de uma cor só, fio de luz no topo e um aperto rápido.

name: Halftone Wordmark Footer
description: Rodapé com o nome da marca enorme, cortado pela borda de baixo e impresso em pontos de retícula: os pontos se abrem em volta do mouse e esquentam de cor, e o clique solta uma onda de choque pela palavra.

name: Hélice
description: Hero com o texto à esquerda e, no painel, duas fitas de luz granulada que se enroscam como um DNA em volta da marca.

name: Holo Card
description: Cartão de passe que inclina em 3D sob o ponteiro, numa mola que passa do ponto e volta: a folha holográfica e o brilho seguem o mouse na hora, e a sombra no chão anda para o outro lado.

name: Holo Trading Card
description: Carta colecionável de foil holográfico em WebGL2, como uma Pikachu ex brilhante: inclina com o mouse e o arco-íris anda pela carta com o ângulo. Clique para virar.

name: Indicator Chart
description: Gráfico de um ativo em três painéis num eixo só: o preço com a área embaixo, o RSI e o MACD com o histograma. O cursor marca o dia nos três, e trocar o período redesenha as linhas.

name: Interactive Selector
description: Faixa de fotos lado a lado em que a escolhida abre e as outras viram tiras: a moldura acende, a foto se afasta e o título entra deslizando ao lado do ícone.

name: Limalha
description: Limalha de ferro sobre papel desenhando os arcos de dois ímãs; o cursor é mais um ímã, e os traços de aço cintilam ao girar.

name: Liquid Glass Dock
description: Dock de ícones de vidro líquido, como a do macOS: um filtro SVG desfoca e entorta o fundo que passa atrás, e no hover a dock e o ícone crescem numa mola.

name: Liquid Glass
description: Botão de vidro líquido que refrata de verdade o que passa atrás: um filtro SVG entorta o fundo e nove sombras desenham a borda.

name: Mercúrio
description: Botão em pílula com anel de metal líquido em shader e orbe prateado com a seta que troca no hover.

name: Moldura
description: Luz com grão que corre só pelas bordas, em lóbulos fluidos, e estica na direção do cursor.

name: Nebulosa
description: Duas manchas de luz com grão de filme que respiram nos cantos opostos, sobre preto.

name: Perspective Tunnel Hero
description: Hero de tela inteira em que a rolagem vira viagem: os cartões nascem no fundo de um túnel 3D, passam em volta do título e saem pela tela. O mouse mexe a câmera.

name: Polaroid Line Carousel
description: Fotos instantâneas presas por pregadores num varal que cede no meio. Arraste o varal e as fotos deslizam por ele, balançando com a velocidade que você der; a do meio é a que está à vista, com o título e a legenda embaixo.

name: Pontilhado
description: Uma bola de luz em pontilhado de 1 bit, verde-fósforo, com uma lupa que revela o degradê liso por baixo.

name: Progress Metric Card
description: Cartão de indicador com o número grande e o gráfico atrás dele, sobre um fundo de pontos: curva ou barras, a variação no período, o menu de 7, 14 e 30 dias e o balão do ponto sob o mouse.

name: Progressive Blur Card
description: Cartão de foto com o pé desfocado aos poucos, sem linha, onde pousam o título e a seta. No hover o cartão cresce, a foto aproxima e a seta gira.

name: Relevo
description: Seção com o painel do produto em perspectiva: inclina com o cursor, se monta ao entrar na tela e escreve o texto sozinho.

name: Sign In Page
description: Tela de login em duas colunas: e-mail e senha em campos de vidro que acendem em violeta, o olho da senha, Google e criar conta, e à direita uma foto com depoimentos em vidro fosco, tudo entrando em sequência.

name: Tipos
description: Fumaça âmbar escrita em caracteres, num monitor antigo; perto do cursor as letras embaralham como um letreiro de aeroporto.

name: Topografia
description: Mapa topográfico vivo: curvas de nível de luz sobre um terreno que respira, e o cursor levanta um morro.

name: Web3 Bento
description: Painel de carteira cripto em bento: patrimônio com o PnL de cada dia, cartões empilhados, gas ao vivo, a carteira contra o ETH, staking rendendo por segundo, faixa de liquidez, blocos chegando e a atividade onchain.

name: Works Wheel
description: Portfólio em roda: os trabalhos em anel em volta do título se abrem num tambor 3D com a rolagem, e cada giro traz a próxima peça para a frente.

name: Alto
description: Internet rural via satélite: um satélite 3D branco cruza o título suíço e desce com a página até a casa no campo.

name: Aroeira
description: Casa de temporada em Ilhabela: um plano contínuo preso ao scroll sai do living, passa sobre a piscina e sobe até a mata.

name: Brasa
description: Hamburgueria de balcão com atitude: ao rolar, a palavra SMASH desce como a espátula e esmaga o nome na chapa, com faíscas.

name: Breu
description: Perfumaria noturna num jardim escuro que desce com o scroll, com um fio de luz que corre por uma raiz e acende as notas.

name: Classe G
description: Utilitário de luxo no escuro e no branco: o vídeo abre como uma íris dentro do farol e os closes de estúdio seguem o scroll.

name: Cláusula
description: Direito empresarial em preto e branco com grão de filme: um contrato é revisado em vermelho enquanto se rola, até a assinatura.

name: Corda
description: Relógio automático num site todo preto: o filme preso ao scroll atravessa o vidro até o balanço e abre o relógio em peças.

name: Fermento
description: Pizzaria napolitana: a mesma pizza atravessa o site, se parte em oito, gira no cardápio, entra no forno e fecha na caixa.

name: Gaivota
description: Drone dobrável nos Lençóis Maranhenses: ele decola da duna com o scroll e a tela do controle sobe por cima da paisagem.

name: Grau
description: Ótica com óculos 3D ao vivo: a página nasce desfocada e só fica nítida pela lente, das armações ao estojo.

name: Lastro
description: Banco digital para empresas: um cartão de titânio em 3D inclina com o cursor e, no scroll, vira e encaixa na tela do app.

name: M4 Competition
description: O coupé gira com o scroll num palco preto, na frente de uma palavra gigante que troca de COMPETITION para 530 CV e 3,9 S.

name: Margem
description: Estúdio de design em que o scroll atravessa um túnel de trabalhos: cada projeto sai da parede e vira a abertura do case.

name: Mia
description: Estúdio de anúncios UGC com uma criadora de IA: ela entra andando e acena em 3D, vira nuvem de pontos com o scroll e os pontos formam o nome cromado.

name: Mosaik
description: SaaS escuro e monocromático, com a marca em metal escovado 3D que gira com o scroll e vaza para a seção seguinte.

name: Nanquim
description: Casa de tatuagem em preto e vermelho: rolando, um cravo fine line se tatua numa foto de antebraço, num shader WebGL.

name: Norte
description: Hospedagem de sites: um globo 3D grafite gira com a mão sob a palavra gigante Online, e um ponto aceso dele pousa no .com da busca.

name: Nota
description: App financeiro para MEI: papéis 3D giram no azul-cobalto e, ao rolar, voam e se empilham em volta de um celular.

name: Prado
description: Gestão financeira para pequenas empresas: o painel ao vivo surge de trás das colinas e a página desce até um rodapé de vidro.

name: Proa
description: Charter de iate contado como um dia a bordo: quatro planos de drone presos ao scroll e um relógio que gira das 7h às 22h.

name: Prumo
description: Construtora de casas de alto padrão: cinco planos de drone presos ao scroll mostram a obra, do terreno à entrega da chave.

name: Rastro
description: Test-drive noturno em cartaz underground: o 911 desce a serra num vídeo em halftone preso ao scroll, com uma mira que segue o carro.

name: Sereno
description: Perfume autoral noturno: o vídeo do frasco avança com o scroll e conta a madrugada em três atos, de 02:47 a 05:12.

name: Sinal
description: Estúdio criativo de IA em WebGL 1-bit: a esfera explode em pontos que formam o título e descem a página como um fluxo.

name: Sopro
description: Estúdio criativo em que o mouse pinta uma tinta com massa e, por dentro dela, revela o nome em letras infladas vermelhas.

name: Taboa
description: Cachaça em três madeiras: a garrafa fica no centro e, rolando, fundo, líquido e rótulo trocam de amburana para bálsamo e carvalho.

name: Tecla
description: Teclado mecânico em 3D feito no código: ao rolar, ele se abre em cinco camadas, as teclas afundam quando você digita e ele vira.

name: Torra
description: Cafeteria com torra própria: a miniatura entre "Torra®" e "Café" cresce até a tela cheia e vira um filme de três capítulos.

name: Traço
description: Estúdio de tatuagem fina: rolando, um beija-flor se tatua traço por traço num antebraço que passa na frente do nome gigante.

name: Trilha
description: Plataforma de portfólio para designers contada como uma descida de montanha, com uma trilha de caneta que se desenha no scroll.

name: Veio
description: Ateliê de joias de prata e turmalina: o scroll roda o filme de uma mão com anéis, que encolhe e vira o primeiro produto da loja.

name: Vulto
description: Loja de streetwear bordado à mão: o moletom em 3D gira com o scroll até a aranha das costas e abre uma loja de verdade.

name: Zênite
description: Hero de energia solar: uma casa em miniatura flutua num pedaço de terra no céu, entre nuvens que seguem o cursor.

name: Esse é o Claude
description: Anúncio de produto de IA: a frase que vira um só pensamento, o pedido digitado no chat, a vitrine do que ele constrói e o código, no ritmo da trilha.

name: Nova Feature
description: Lançamento de funcionalidade de SaaS: título com o ícone da feature, o fluxo real no app com cursor e zoom, o resultado no canvas e o domínio no fecho.
